title: Military power: how it ruled and how it ended
goal: I can compare how the military ruled in several countries and how their rule ended, using formal cause connectors.
grammar: formal cause connectors like debido a and a raíz de

items: I can say what the military governments had in common.
I can say how the governments differed.
I can say why the governments lost support.
I can use *debido a* and *a raíz de* to give a cause.
I can explain a cause using *debido a* or *a raíz de*.
I can say what the military governments had in common.
I can say how some of them differed.
I can say how the military left power in Argentina, Uruguay, Brazil and Chile.
I can say what historians discuss about the end of these governments.
